explication: ReShade injects into games and video software to access frame color and depth, run post-processing effects, and expose an API for add-ons. The principal runtime path is application graphics activity through API hooks and adapters into the effect runtime, with results presented through the overlay. The repository also contains a standalone ReShade FX compiler and a depth-detection capability. The README documents these product relationships; sampled source excerpts show add-on loading and graphics-event interception, but do not establish every runtime connection in detail.
